description: First-filament and highest-used-filament bed temperatures at initial and ordinary-layer transitions.

mutants.description: The first-layer formula must select either filament 0 temperature or the highest used-filament temperature, with both filaments exercised and the selected command position/type checked.
The post-first-layer bed transition must use the same selected-filament formula as the first-layer command, with the complete two-command sequence checked.
